doc.title: Victor Rendon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, November 15, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Writing with Finale
summary: Brief exchange about Finale versus Sibelius.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: I did not hear them before but I know before you worked on it yesterday they put a recording of it on. Do you write with Finale or anything like that?
I use Finale yes, yes, yes. Some people say Sibelius is better. I don’t know.
They do say that but I’m a Finale guy also.
Because I’ve done it for over twenty years, I’m not going to change now.
